name: GAIA
titleZh: GAIA：通用 AI 助手基准
summary: 466 real-world questions that are easy for humans but demand reasoning, multi-modality, browsing and tool use in combination.
summaryZh: 466 个真实世界问题，对人类容易，但要求同时具备推理、多模态、网页浏览与工具使用能力。
keyFact: GAIA (Mialon et al., arXiv:2311.12983, 2023-11-21) released 466 questions and reported human respondents at 92% against 15% for GPT-4 equipped with plugins.
keyFactZh: GAIA（Mialon 等，arXiv:2311.12983，2023-11-21）发布 466 道题，报告人类正确率为 92%，而接入插件的 GPT-4 为 15%。
whyItMatters: Its framing inverted the usual benchmarking treadmill: it asks for human-level robustness on easy-looking questions rather than superhuman feats.
whyItMattersZh: 它的取向与常见的基准军备竞赛相反：要的是人类在简单问题上的那种稳健，而不是超越人类的壮举。
title: GAIA: a benchmark for General AI Assistants
